name: fufu-toolskit
description: Monorepo for y2k-nav, fufu-combine, fufu-act/activity, and network-detect.

scripts.deps: npm run deps:combine && npm run deps:act && npm run deps:network
scripts.test:act: node --check apps/fufu-act/server/index.mjs && node --check apps/fufu-act/server/routes.mjs && node --check apps/fufu-act/server/slot.mjs && node --check apps/fufu-act/server/db.mjs && node --check apps/fufu-act/server/credit-worker.mjs && node --check apps/fufu-act/scripts/api-act.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:combine && npm run test:act && npm run test:network
